case.summary: Case HHG-012 was opened for customer C05876 following a real-time risk alert on in-person transaction 3553342 for $30.91 on 2016-12-18 04:00:31. The transaction occurred on card C05876-K2 in billing region 494 for product W, representing an out-of-region use pattern that accounts for only 2.3% of the card's prior activity. Following inquiry, the customer confirmed they did not authorize the purchase and still retain possession of the card. With a calibrated model fraud probability of 0.95, the incident is confirmed as fraud, resulting in the card being blocked and the case logged.
